source_portal: TNAU Agritech Portal - Crop Production - Rice Water Management
regional_focus: Western Agroclimatic Zone of Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Erode)

alternate_wetting_and_drying_awd.name: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) / Safe AWD (Pani Pipe)
alternate_wetting_and_drying_awd.description: Recommended by TNAU to save 20-30% of irrigation water without yield penalty. A 15-20 cm perforated plastic tube (pani pipe) is inserted in the field to monitor the water table.

implementation_guidelines.nursery: Maintain thin film of water (1-2 cm) during germination and nursery stage.
implementation_guidelines.tillering_to_panicle_initiation: Irrigate to 5 cm depth after ponded water naturally drops to ground level (0 cm on surface, or 15 cm below surface in safe AWD tube).
implementation_guidelines.flowering_reproductive_stage: CRITICAL STAGE! Strictly do not practice AWD. Maintain continuous 5 cm (50 mm) standing water from panicle initiation to 10 days after flowering to avoid spikelet sterility.
implementation_guidelines.grain_filling_to_maturity: Intermittent shallow irrigation (2.5-3.0 cm). Completely drain water 10-15 days prior to harvest to facilitate uniform ripening.

Clay.characteristics: High clay content creates an impermeable puddled plow pan; water is retained longer.

Clay Loam.characteristics: Favorable water retention; suitable for controlled AWD cycles.

Loamy.characteristics: Medium texture; standard recommendation in Coimbatore plains.

Sandy Loam.characteristics: Rapid percolation; requires frequent light irrigations; bund sealing essential.

Sandy.characteristics: High percolation losses; generally discouraged for wetland paddy unless heavily amended.

critical_stages_ranked_by_water_stress_s.impact_of_stress: Spikelet sterility, poor heading, severe yield drop up to 50%

critical_stages_ranked_by_water_stress_s.mandatory_management: Shallow water (20-30 mm) or Safe AWD
Saturated soil to shallow thin film (10-20 mm)
